# WAFT

GeoMono uses the WAFT-a1 optical-flow network with the tar-c-t checkpoint. The runtime configuration is in `config/a1/tar-c-t.json`. The bundled feature extractor supplies intermediate features for optical flow. See the upstream implementation and its license for attribution. [WAFT repository](https://github.com/princeton-vl/WAFT) · [License](LICENSE)

Yihan Wang and Jia Deng, *WAFT: Warping-Alone Field Transforms for Optical Flow*. [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.21526)
